# PropertyPredictionModeling

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The use of supervised or unsupervised learning to map material composition and structure to functional properties such as conductivity or switching behavior. Critical for identifying nanomaterial candidates that exhibit the nonlinear dynamics required for spiking neural network implementations.
